name: Public Marketing Home
user: Prospective customer/visitor on a public marketing surface.
primary_task: Understand the offering and take the primary conversion CTA.
success_state: The visitor reaches the primary destination (docs, components, or newsletter success) from a real link.
failure_recovery: Newsletter 422 inline alert preserves the email; 404/500 render error-state with retry (R-ERROR-01/02).
no_js_flow: Complete: all CTAs are real links; the newsletter is a native POST form with 422 inline feedback; the language switcher is a GET form with a visible submit; the video uses native controls.
htmx_enhancement: Optional newsletter aside swap; no mutation contract change (R-NOJS-03).
